use_case: Inductively code personal-data and data-protection concerns using released issue metadata and fixed supplemental issue-body/comment snapshots, explicitly retaining evidence gaps.
data_description: The original study analyzed 652 privacy-related GitHub issues. Its released CSV contains titles, metadata and hidden reference annotations. CODA separately retrieves available issue bodies and issue comments into a dated, checksummed local snapshot; this is not the original historical discussion snapshot.
